name: GET /api/leadflow/contacts/:id/conversations - thread and compose gate
description:
The unified thread plus the live compose guardrail.

THE ENGINE'S SENTENCE IS RENDERED VERBATIM. Composed in the browser it would drift from the wording that was actually decided, and a dispute is settled against what the engine said, not against a paraphrase.

When the conversation service is unreachable the thread is unknown but the GUARDRAILS ARE STILL EVALUATED and safe to act on — which is the useful half during an outage.

Carries upstream_available and field_gaps like every read in this workspace: a panel that renders blank when an SDK is down is indistinguishable from one rendering a person who genuinely has no history. QA: measured live against a real contact from the list.

testCases.name: The conversations panel returns its data with the reachability of each upstream
NEGATIVE: no contact with that id
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the contact id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
